title: camissonia boothii subsp. rutila
intro: Camissonia boothii subsp. rutila, commonly known as Dune Suncup, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Onagraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine, and research has identified its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dune Suncup are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Camissonia boothii subsp. rutila include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
